description: Replaced the `spectral` MLP initialization logic which incorrectly assigned class variables (`self.x`, `self.x0`, `self.y`, `self.lm_head`) to forward pass parameters (`self.resid_lambdas`, `self.x0_lambdas`, `self.y`, `self.lm_head`) in the `Block` class, causing the `MuonAdamW` optimizer to fail initialization on the first step due to uninitialized tensors passed to the MLP.
